title: report.py status --output-mode json
description: Post-processing job queue and table counts as one record: one table, one row, one column per metric (rows[0].settings_jobs_pending, ...), always these columns in this order; each job status is a column of its own, 0 when it has no jobs. txt/markdown show the table transposed, one labelled line per metric.

settings_jobs_pending.description: settings_jobs rows with status 'pending'; 0 when there are none.

settings_jobs_processing.description: settings_jobs rows with status 'processing'; 0 when there are none.

settings_jobs_done.description: settings_jobs rows with status 'done'; 0 when there are none.

settings_jobs_failed.description: settings_jobs rows with status 'failed'; 0 when there are none.

settings_jobs_eligible.description: Pending settings jobs whose next_retry_at has passed.

settings_jobs_in_backoff.description: Pending settings jobs still waiting for next_retry_at.

support_probe_jobs_pending.description: Outstanding support_probe_jobs rows with status 'pending' (settled probes leave the queue, GitHub issue #139); 0 when there are none.

support_probe_jobs_processing.description: Outstanding support_probe_jobs rows with status 'processing' (settled probes leave the queue, GitHub issue #139); 0 when there are none.

support_probe_jobs_due_for_recheck.description: support_probe_results rows whose next_eligible_at is unset or has passed.

support_probe_jobs_in_cooldown.description: support_probe_results rows whose next_eligible_at is still in the future.

scan_pending_support_sweep.description: Id of the newest processed settings scan (settings_job_generator_runs) not yet followed by a support sweep; null when there is none.

templates_last_synced_at.description: Last successful templates sync; null if templates were never synced.

templates_last_synced_commit.description: Templates repo HEAD SHA at the last successful sync; null if never synced.
